policy.authorization_rule: The complete macro body, claim ID, and manuscript section must exactly match authorized_tex and allowed_locations.
policy.artifact_rule: Quantitative table or figure claims require an authorized artifact ID, generated output, provenance sidecar, and manuscript binding.
policy.prose_rule: Claim-bearing quantitative, accuracy, validation, parity, and performance prose outside a registered macro or artifact is prohibited.
policy.working_tree_rule: Uncommitted scientific inputs are never evidence; paper-owned generated sources are hash-bound pending integration.

claims.authorized_tex: All 8,192 records and 26 published numeric fields passed the documented Python/CUDA binary64 comparison; no point failed or was rejected. Maximum relative particle, mass, current, and beam-power conservation residuals were $2.36837\times10^{-16}$, $3.24198\times10^{-16}$, $4.10551\times10^{-16}$, and $4.43207\times10^{-16}$, respectively.

The recorded end-to-end CUDA diagnostic was 0.634302~s (12,914.99 points/s), and separate Python reference construction was 0.141245~s. The observation includes preprocessing, allocations, transfers, synchronization, and Python record construction. It was a single shared-GPU diagnostic without controlled clocks, warm-up protocol, repetitions, or a kernel-only interval. The two timings are not a comparative benchmark and establish neither acceleration nor regression.
permitted_scope: verbatim diagnostic timings with mandatory caveat
